name: Orbital Settings screen
description: Design Graph of the Orbital SettingsPage (Uno Platform) including the PageHeader instance it renders. Built from full XAML/C# source and the Orbital style dictionaries.

sourceSummary.label: Orbital style dictionaries (brushes, text styles, surfaces, buttons, animation constants)

evidence.rationale: Page class Orbital.Presentation.SettingsPage; header Title='Settings'.

properties.layout: vertical AutoLayout, spacing 24, responsive padding (Narrow 16 / Normal 32 / Wide 32); section cards below the profile card sit in a two-column grid with a 16px gutter

properties.api: Title and Subtitle dependency properties; static SearchRequested event raised when the search bar is tapped

evidence.rationale: Reusable UserControl declared in Orbital.Controls.

properties.interaction: Tapped raises static PageHeader.SearchRequested event; pointer-over swaps border/background brushes in code-behind (style-level hover, not modeled as a state)

evidence.rationale: Clickable Border with Tapped handler and AutomationProperties.Name.

properties.surface: Surface-1 background, 1px Surface-3 border, 12px radius, 20px padding

evidence.rationale: Shared OrbitalCardStyle consumed by all four section cards on this screen.

properties.behavior: Click persists the trimmed textbox value via SettingsService.SaveUsername

evidence.rationale: Primary button style is source-declared; click handler saves the username.

nodes.name: Display name helper text
nodes.text: This name appears in the homepage greeting.

properties.structure: single-row grid: muted label left-aligned, value right-aligned, both OrbitalMonoSmall

evidence.rationale: Four structurally identical label/value grids in the About card share child roles, styles, and purpose; consolidated as one reusable concept (not source-declared as a control).
Common label slot across the four About-card rows.
Common right-aligned value slot across the four About-card rows; all bound with '...' fallback.

properties.structure: stacked label over wrapping monospace path value, 8px gap

evidence.rationale: Three structurally identical stacked label/value StackPanels in the Paths card share styles, spacing, and purpose; consolidated as one reusable concept.
Common label slot across the three Paths-card fields.
Common wrapping value slot across the three Paths-card fields; all bound with '...' fallback.

properties.structure: left-aligned, full-width ghost button with 14px FontIcon + text label, 8px gap

evidence.rationale: Three structurally identical icon+text ghost buttons in the Actions card share style, layout, and purpose; consolidated as one reusable concept.
Common FontIcon slot; glyph varies per instance (E74D, E838, E8A5).
Common text-label slot; text varies per instance.

properties.label: Clear Recent Projects
properties.behavior: Click removes all recent projects via IProjectContext, then shows a 'Cleared' ContentDialog

properties.label: Open Data Folder
properties.behavior: Click opens the Orbital LocalApplicationData folder in the OS shell (creates it if missing)

properties.label: Uno Platform Documentation
properties.behavior: Click launches external URI https://platform.uno/docs/articles/intro.html in the default browser (external, so no navigates-to edge)

properties.description: On Loaded, the four section cards start at Opacity 0 / TranslateY 8 and fade up via AnimationHelper.FadeUp with 0/100/200/300ms staggered delays (Profile, About, Paths, Actions).

evidence.rationale: Whole-screen staggered entrance orchestrated from the page's Loaded handler.

properties.description: Save button content flips to 'Saved!' for 1500ms after a click, then reverts to 'Save'.
A modal ContentDialog titled 'Cleared' with body 'Recent projects list has been cleared.' and an OK close button, shown on the page's XamlRoot after clearing recents.

evidence.rationale: Dialog overlays the whole screen (XamlRoot-scoped), so the state attaches to the screen.

unresolved.question: What UI does the header search bar open? Tapping it raises the static PageHeader.SearchRequested event, but no subscriber is visible in the allowed sources.
unresolved.reason: The event is declared but its handler lives outside the modeled files; asserting a navigates-to or triggers target would be invention.

unresolved.question: Is the Ctrl+K shortcut shown in the search badge actually registered as a keyboard accelerator?
unresolved.reason: The badge is purely visual in PageHeader.xaml; no KeyboardAccelerator appears in the allowed sources.

unresolved.question: What object provides the bound values (VersionDisplay, EnvStatus.*, DotNetDisplay, PlatformInfo, ProjectRoot, RecentsPath, SkillsPath)? No DataContext or ViewModel assignment is visible in the allowed sources.
unresolved.reason: Binding paths are declared in XAML but the binding source is outside the modeled files; the data model must not be invented.

unresolved.question: Is the About-left / Paths+Actions-right two-column arrangement semantically meaningful, or purely a width-driven layout choice? It is modeled as layout properties on the cards rather than as column regions.
unresolved.reason: The grid columns look like drawing-layer layout with no separate semantic identity, but an alternate reading treats each column as a region.

metadata.notes: Style-level interaction visuals (button PointerOver/Pressed/Disabled visual states, search-bar hover brush swaps) are excluded per the v0.2 state-altitude rule; tokens are limited to values the Settings surface consumes at rest, directly or via styles it uses.
